contributions.detail: 11 Schedule A rows sum to 200.00 + 4000.00 + 250.00 + 100.00 + 5000.00 + 500.00 + 200.00 + 2000.00 + 5000.00 + 100.00 + 2000.00 = 19,350.00 exactly. FOUR printed anchors agree to the cent (schedule page subtotal, schedule grand total, cover line 1 Column A, cover lines 4/5). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is LEFT WHOLLY BLANK by this filer on both lines — there is no cumulative figure on this document, so nothing was differenced and nothing was summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures, line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE = 11,473.47 on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE — the same figure printed again at summary line 6 ('From Line 2 Column A'), at Schedule B's own 'Subtotal for this page' $11,473.47 and at its 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' $11,473.47
expenditures.detail: 18 Schedule B rows sum to 1500.00 + 569.48 + 4504.81 + 300.00 + 600.00 + 100.00 + 18.14 + 98.46 + 787.52 + 596.73 + 23.50 + 214.35 + 829.25 + 64.05 + 640.00 + 200.00 + 77.18 + 350.00 = 11,473.47 exactly, matching all four printed anchors. ONE CELL WAS ESCALATED TO SETTLE ITS LEGIBILITY: line 16 (Utah County Sheriff's Assoc) reads as a possible '300.00' at page resolution, which would leave the schedule +100.00 over its own printed subtotal. A 2000 dpi tight crop of that cell shows a leading digit drawn with a bottom horizontal sweep — the filer's own '2' form — and NOT the two-open-curves shape he uses for '3' three lines below on the same page (350,00) and at line 4 (300.00). The closure is UNIQUE: no other cell on this schedule is ambiguous by 100, so the delta is attributable to exactly one cell and it resolves to 200.00. Arithmetic closure and glyph reading agree. The balance ladder also closes: line 3 beginning 0 + line 4 19,350.00 = line 5 19,350.00, minus line 6 11,473.47 = line 7 7,876.53.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed exactly on BOTH sides (19,350.00 and 11,473.47). Both conventions were tested and are numerically identical here: neither schedule prints an in-kind column, the cover prints no separate in-kind line, and no row is marked in-kind.
itemized.escalation_note: SIX tight-cell escalations. (1) 2000 dpi on the p4 line-16 amount — the only escalation that settled a FIGURE: it resolved the +100.00 discrepancy to a leading '2' (200.00), corroborated by the filer's own '3' glyph elsewhere on the same page and by unique arithmetic closure. (2) 2000 dpi on the p4 line-18 amount — confirmed the decimal separator is a handwritten COMMA ('350,00'), the single whitelisted repair, with raised underlined cents. (3-4) 1600 dpi on the p3 line-1 and line-3 donor names. (5-6) 900 dpi strip crops of the p3 and p4 amount columns and of the p4 date column, to read cents and dates that the full page could not resolve. Escalation resolved legibility only; the document's own arithmetic governed throughout.

The seat is NOT inferred here; the page-face office is recorded as printed and the disagreement is flagged, per the module's standing do-not. Report type ticked '30 Days after withdraw or elimination'; cover date 5/14/2014, but Schedule B's own header block is dated 5/20/14 — the filer dated the cover and the schedule six days apart, both kept as printed. Party 'Republican'; amendment ticked 'No'. FOUR pages: p1 cover (2014 blank, Utah County Code 2-5) / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3 SCHEDULE A / p4 SCHEDULE B, each classified from its own printed heading. FORM-VINTAGE NOTE: pages 2-4 of this filing carry a small printed '2014 County Candidate' slug in the top-left corner that the Allen filing in the same batch does not — a second 2014 schedule blank circulating alongside the one whose Schedule B is headed 'Purchased From/Source'. Here BOTH schedules use the OLDER heading set ('Name of Contributor' / 'Mailing Address & Zip Code'), so Schedule B has no Purpose column. Summary line 3 (Balance at Beginning) is a handwritten looped ZERO and reads 0 under the zero-glyph ruling; both Column B (Year-to-Date) cells are left entirely blank. PRIVACY: this filing is UNREDACTED — full donor street lines are legible on p3 — and no street line, box number or phone number reached this record; contributions carry city/state only where the page prints them, expenditures carry no address field at all. SOURCE PROPERTY: a filer may continue his ledger BELOW the last printed rule (line 18 here), which no arithmetic gate can see and only a crop can catch — a fourth way a row index can go wrong alongside the skipped first line, the continuation line and the voided row.
